Caitlin Conley (born 1985/1986) is an American politician and national security official. She is the Democratic nominee for the U.S. House of Representatives for New York's 17th district in the 2026 election, challenging incumbent Republican Mike Lawler.
Conley served as an officer in the U.S. Army for 16 years with overseas deployments to Iraq and Afghanistan. Conley later led the Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA)'s election security efforts during the 2024 elections and was a director for counterterrorism on the National Security Council.

She worked as a television journalist in Pennsylvania for more than three decades, including 26 years as an anchor at WGAL-TV in Lancaster. Stelson was the Democratic nominee for Pennsylvania's 10th congressional district in 2024, narrowly losing to incumbent Republican Scott Perry, and is the party's nominee again in the 2026 election.

records.wikipediaIntro:
Houston Alexander Gaines (born January 11, 1995) is an American politician from Georgia. Gaines has been a Republican member of the Georgia House of Representatives since 2019.
In July 2025, he became the first prominent Republican to enter the race for the open U.S. House of Representatives seat in Georgia's 10th congressional district currently represented by Republican Mike Collins, who is the Republican nominee in the 2026 U.S. Senate election in Georgia.
In April 2026, President Donald Trump and U.S. Speaker of the House Mike Johnson endorsed Gaines in the Republican primary for Georgia's 10th congressional district.

La Shawn K. Ford (born February 28, 1972) is an American politician who is a Democratic member of the Illinois House of Representatives, representing the 8th district since 2007. The district includes the West Side of Chicago and the suburbs of Oak Park, Berwyn, North Riverside, Forest Park, Proviso Township, Brookfield, La Grange Park, La Grange, and Western Springs.
Ford was a candidate for Mayor of Chicago in the 2019 election. He is the Democratic nominee for the United States House of Representatives in Illinois's 7th congressional district in the 2026 election.

Jim Desmond is an American politician and retired aviator serving as a member of the San Diego County Board of Supervisors since 2019, representing the fifth district. A member of the Republican Party, he previously served as vice chair of the board from 2020 to 2021, mayor of San Marcos, California from 2006 to 2018, and as a member of the San Marcos city council from 2004 to 2006.
In 2025, Desmond announced his candidacy for California's 49th congressional district in the 2026 election. In 2026, he announced that he would instead run in California's 48th congressional district after being redistricted into the district by Proposition 50.

records.wikipediaIntro: Seth Andrew Bodnar (born February 2, 1979) is an American academic administrator, U.S. Army veteran, and business executive who was the 19th president of the University of Montana. He is a graduate of West Point and was a Rhodes Scholar with master's degrees from Hertford College, Oxford. He remains an active military officer in the Montana National Guard. In January 2026, Bodnar resigned his post as president of the University of Montana, and two months later he officially announced his run for U.S. Senate in 2026.

Nancy S. Lacore (born 1968/1969 in Albany, New York) is a retired United States Navy officer and political candidate who served as the 16th Chief of Navy Reserve from 2024 to 2025. A vice admiral, she previously served as the 93rd commandant of Naval District Washington from 2022 to 2024. She also served as the director of the Maritime Partnership Program, U.S. Naval Forces Europe/Africa/U.S. 6th Fleet, with additional duties as vice commander of U.S. 6th Fleet in Naples, Italy.
Lacore is the Democratic nominee for the South Carolina 1st congressional district in 2026, seeking to fill the seat being vacated by Republican incumbent Nancy Mace, whose term will expire in 2027.
